canonical_membership_note: Membership taken from the published .ds files, not directory listings. The repository README warns that directories contain more PDB files than the datasets define (holo4k/ has 4543 files vs holo4k.ds 4009 entries).

CHEN11.role_evidence: P2Rank (Krivak & Hoksza 2018): the distributed default model is trained on CHEN11. Repository README lists CHEN11 as a main protein set used 'for training and evaluation'.

JOINED.role_evidence: P2Rank (Krivak & Hoksza 2018): JOINED (ASTEX + B48 + U48 + DT198 + B210) is used for model selection / hyperparameter choice.

COACH420.role_evidence: P2Rank (Krivak & Hoksza 2018): COACH420 is an evaluation/test set.

HOLO4K.role_evidence: P2Rank (Krivak & Hoksza 2018): HOLO4K is an evaluation/test set. README: 'Disjunct with CHEN11 and JOINED.'

FPTRAIN.role_evidence: p2rank-datasets README, verbatim: 'FPTRAIN: dataset used by Fpocket for training its pocket scoring function'.

COACH420_mlig.role_evidence: README: '(mlig) datasets contain explicitly specified relevant ligands. Valid ligand codes come from MOAD 2013 database.'
